thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: PagerDuty page fired -> service=infra:inference-gateway-prod, symptom=5xx-error-rate > 7% (1m), region=us-west1, source=error-rate-policy

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident #PD-8231 - Unhandled 5xx spike (auto-page). Escalation chain: oncall -> rotation.

jordan: Acking. I'm oncall for the next 30m. Initial glance?

tanvi: thx jordan. seeing a sharp jump in 502/503s coming from the edge LB to inference-gateway (us-west1). spike started ~00:08 UTC.

omar: +1 logs show a flood of `upstream reset` and `connection refused` from edge-proxy -> gateway-backend. suspect new edge config rollout at 23:55 UTC.

leah: checking deploys now — release `edge-proxy:v3.18.0` was promoted to prod at 23:54. Canary passed earlier but volume much higher now.

tanvi: rolling tail of edge-proxy logs:```\nERROR 00:09:12 proxy_conn.go:142 upstream reset for connID=0x7f3b\nWARN 00:09:12 keepalive_mgr.go:88 failed keepalive handshake: EOF\nERROR 00:09:13 lb_balancer.go:210 conn pool exhausted, queueing request```

jordan: are we seeing customer impact? any 429s or timeouts reported to support?

tanvi: dashboards show 5xx spike correlates with increased latency to upstream services; top client impact is streaming endpoints (long-lived connections) — small number of customers affected but noticeable.

pagerduty: auto-ack failed — incident escalated to rotation.

omar: quick mitigation options: 1) rollback edge-proxy to v3.17.4, 2) increase upstream connection pool temporarily, 3) route a portion of traffic away from us-west1 to us-east1 (traffic-slice).

leah: rollback is fastest but will cause a rolling restart of pods; might drop some in-flight connections. increasing pool is config-only (hot reload) — prefer try that first.

jordan: do it. tanvi/omar, can one of you push pool bump in edge config? provide the exact command.

omar: doing hot config bump now — using internal config api:```\n# bump keepalive pool size from 500 -> 1500\ncurl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API" \\\n  https://config.internal/edge-proxy/us-west1 -d '{"connection_pool":1500}'\n```

omar: posted, config accepted, starting to roll to all nodes (hot apply).

sre-rotations-bot: NOTE: config-change applied to 12/12 nodes in us-west1 (0 restarts).

tanvi: metrics are starting to improve — 5xx rate down to ~3.2% within 90s. latency tail still elevated but trending down.

jordan: awesome. leave PD incident open for 15m to monitor, but downgrade priority if steady. Can we also add a short blam-proof note: cause likely regressed edge config push interacting poorly with long-lived streaming connections.

leah: logged a post-incident ticket: ENG-PI-1522 (edge rollout -> keepalive regression). will schedule follow-up with edge team in the morning.

omar: quick note for postmortem: capture traffic profile (long-lived vs short) that caused conn pool exhaustion + include heap of edge-proxy logs at spike window.

pagerduty: PD incident #PD-8231 updated: status=acknowledged by jordan; priority remains P2; escalation paused.

jordan: moving to watch. if anyone sees >5% for 3m continuously, re-alert here and I'll re-escalate.

tanvi: copying repro snippet for the postmortem:```\n# simulate many long-lived connections\nfor i in $(seq 1 2000); do nc -vz edge-proxy.us-west1.internal 443 & done\n```

leah: support notified: sent short customer advisory to support channel, advising transient errors and that engineering is investigating.

omar: follow-up actions assigned: edge-team to revert problematic default keepalive timeout in canary; infra to add an alert for connection-pool-utilization > 80%; platform to add safe-rollback flag for critical rollouts.

jordan: thanks team. I'll tidy the incident notes and close in 20m if stable. good job moving fast. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT SUMMARY: service=infra:inference-gateway-prod, symptom=5xx spike, root_cause=edge-proxy config change interacting with long-lived connections (probable), mitigation=hot-config bump to increase connection pool, impact=partial customer streaming errors, followups=ENG-PI-1522, owner=leah.

sre-rotations-bot: incident closed by jordan at 1765560300 (monitored for 20m, no regression).
